title: Jesus... Why Am I Always The Last To Know?
topic: her friend group made plans without her and she found out from a story

bible.text: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master's business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... they all went out tonight. I found out from her story. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The group chat I've been in since first year. Nobody even typed my name.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You opened that story four times before you closed the app. I watched every one with you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Did I do something wrong? Why did nobody just tell me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Their silence is about their plans, not your worth. Overlooked is not erased.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I showed up for all of them. Their birthdays, their 2 a.m. calls.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. None of that faithfulness is wasted because they forgot it tonight.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It just hurts that the people closest to me made me feel optional.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You have never been optional to Me. I kept a seat no group chat can remove.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They can leave you off a plan. They cannot leave you off My list.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did you last feel like the extra one? 💔
